At Vanta, our mission is to secure the internet and protect consumer data. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. Our team's mission: "We transform complexity into clarity in every interaction, with empathy, earning the trust of our customers" We build strong partnerships with our customers through trust and transparency, which is why our Technical Support Metrics https://www.vanta.com/technical-support-metrics are public.



As the AI Agent Operations Specialist,You'll own Ask-Ilma, Vanta's customer-facing AI agent, built on Fin by Intercom, and the first point of contact for customers seeking support.. You're accountable for whether customers get the right answer, how the experience feels, and how smoothly Fin hands off to our support engineers when it should. Our customers rely on Vanta to get compliance right, so a fast answer only counts if it's also a correct one.

This is a hands-on role for someone who treats an AI agent like a product: something to measure, tune, test, and improve every week.



What you’ll do as a AI Optimization Specialist, Support at Vanta:


PERFORMANCE: OWN HOW WELL FIN WORKS

An AI agent's performance drifts without a clear owner, and that owner is you. You'll have a bias for action, shipping improvements quickly and learning from the results. You'll also decide with frameworks, so the team always understands why one fix came before another.

 - Review Fin conversations weekly to find wrong answers, self-service gaps, and avoidable escalations.

 - Make changes in Fin yourself (guidance, content, workflows). Treat most as two-way doors: ship, measure, adjust.

 - Keep a ranked list of improvements based on customer impact, volume, and risk.

 - Set and document Fin's guardrails: what it must never answer, when it asks a clarifying question, and when it escalates.


KNOWLEDGE: OWN WHAT FIN KNOWS

Fin is only as accurate as what it knows. Our customers trust Vanta to get compliance right, and we do what it says on the tin, so Fin's knowledge has to be correct and current.

 - Own the knowledge Fin draws from: snippets, internal content, and our help center.

 - Set the governance: every topic has an owner and a review cadence, and outdated or conflicting content gets retired.

 - When a support engineer answers something Fin couldn't, turn it into reusable knowledge so we only answer it once.

 - Set AI-ready content standards, and partner with Customer Education to bring help-center articles up to them.


CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE: OWN HOW FIN FEELS TO CUSTOMERS

For many customers, Fin is the first Vanta "teammate" they talk to. Because we put our customers first, how Fin makes them feel matters as much as what it says.

 - Shape how Fin sounds, including how it says "I don't know" without leaving customers stuck.

 - Own handoffs: when Fin escalates, where it routes, and what context it passes so customers never repeat themselves.

 - Dig into low CSAT ratings and dead ends, and fix the root cause.

 - Handle a small volume of tickets to stay close to real customer problems.


LAUNCH READINESS: OWN FIN'S READINESS FOR EVERY LAUNCH

Vanta ships fast, and customers ask about new features the day they launch. We win as one team and lead with resilience, so Fin is ready on day one, even when plans change late.

 - Partner early with Product, Engineering, and Customer Education to get source-of-truth content before features ship.

 - Have Fin tested and ready on launch day, then watch closely and close gaps fast.

 - Evaluate new Fin capabilities and recommend which to adopt.



How to be successful in this role:

 - Support expertise: 3+ years in technical support at a B2B SaaS company, including troubleshooting complex customer issues. TSS / Sr. TSS experience is preferred.

 - AI support tool experience: hands-on experience with AI-powered support tools, as a user or an admin, and a clear view of where they work well and where they don't.

 - Structured writing: you can turn a messy process into clear, well-organized knowledge that both people and AI can use.

 - Data-driven decisions: you're comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data, spotting trends, and using them to decide what to fix first.

 - Systems thinking: when you see a bad answer, you ask what in the system caused it, then fix that so it doesn't happen again.

 - Customer judgment: you can tell when an answer is technically right but still a bad experience, and when a customer needs a person.

 - Nice to have: Experience administering Intercom and Fin, including guidance, snippets, Procedures, or AI Insights.

 - Nice to have: Background in knowledge management, content design, or writing for conversational interfaces.

 - Nice to have: Experience leading a support tool rollout or migration.

 - Nice to have: Exposure to security, compliance, or GRC concepts.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Upmarket - UK&I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta is looking for a Senior Account Executive for our Upmarket team to take full ownership of the sales cycle in the UK market — bringing in new upmarket logos and helping shape the commercial sales playbook as we scale our EMEA presence.

Vanta is growing quickly, we're profitable, and we're consistently outpacing our growth targets while maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores. Our Sales team is leading the charge in growing market share as the category leader in compliance automation and trust management — and our EMEA commercial motion is a major part of that story.

As a Senior Account Executive in the UK, you'll be one of the key contributors to establishing Vanta's footprint in this market, converting both outbound and inbound pipeline into long-term customers and helping define how we sell to upmarket companies across the region.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals and execute outbound strategies to engage upmarket prospects across the UK and Ireland

  • Own the full sales cycle — from initial outreach through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close

  • Convert inbound demand into closed-won business and long-term Vanta customers

  • Manage and grow your pipeline, contributing to the maturation of Vanta's commercial sales process and playbook

  • Tailor demos and sales materials to communicate the specific value of Vanta for each upmarket buyer

  • Forecast accurately on a monthly and quarterly basis, maintaining strong pipeline hygiene in Salesforce

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Engineering, GRC specialists, Legal, and Deal Desk throughout the sales process

  • Surface prospect insights to inform Vanta's product roadmap and go-to-market strategy

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying closing role, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly targets

  • Proven experience self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold calling into SMB and upmarket accounts

  • Strong background in B2B SaaS, with experience across SMB and upmarket segments

  • Highly empathetic to customers and skilled at building long-term relationships that drive retention

  • Technically fluent enough to understand Vanta's software and build credibility with technical stakeholders and decision-makers

  • Exceptional problem-solver with a passion for making an impact in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

  • Comfortable managing multiple deals simultaneously with varying deal complexity and stakeholder involvement

  • Curious, resourceful, and energized by building in ambiguous, fast-paced startup environments

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Design Systems team is the foundational layer that powers visual consistency, design quality, and engineering velocity across all of Vanta's product surfaces. The Design Systems team builds and maintains Vanta's shared component library, design tokens, interaction patterns, and documentation — enabling product designers and engineers to ship high-quality, cohesive experiences at scale. As Vanta grows across GRC, Trust, Design Systems, and new product areas, the Design Systems team plays a critical role in maintaining quality, reducing design and engineering debt, and accelerating the entire product organization.

What you’ll do as a Staff Product Designer at Vanta:

  • Building and evolving a robust, scalable component library used across every product team

  • Establishing and maintaining design tokens, typography, spacing, color systems, and interaction patterns

  • Creating and enforcing documentation standards, contribution models, and design governance frameworks

  • Partnering with front-end engineering to ensure design-to-code fidelity and maintain a shared component vocabulary

  • Driving design system adoption across product teams through education, tooling, and proactive partnership

  • Evolving the design system to support accessibility and platform scalability across Vanta's growing product suite

  • Deep expertise building and maintaining scalable design systems for complex B2B SaaS products, including component architecture, design tokens, and pattern libraries

  • Strong visual design foundation with mastery of typography, color theory, spacing, interaction design, and accessibility principles

  • Proven ability to govern and evolve a design system at scale, including defining contribution models, usage guidelines, and quality standards across a multi-team design organization

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

How to be successful in this role:

  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer (preferably within Design Systems), with some experience in B2B SaaS or other complex domains

  • Experience collaborating closely with front-end engineers to ensure design-to-code fidelity and maintain a shared vocabulary between design and implementation

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma — including variants, auto-layout, and design tokens — with experience publishing and managing shared libraries at scale across a product organization

  • Lead the strategy, evolution, and execution of Vanta's design system, ensuring it scales with the needs of a rapidly growing product organization

  • Partner with product designers and engineers across all product teams to define, document, and ship new components, patterns, and guidelines

  • Establish governance models, contribution frameworks, and quality standards that enable every designer at Vanta to build consistently

  • Advocate for accessibility and inclusive design as a foundational requirement throughout all components, patterns, and design documentation

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role.

You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success.

This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on.

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta:

  • Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers.

  • Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency.

  • Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned).

  • High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures.

  • Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success.

  • Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities.

  • Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta.

  • Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

  • Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, GRC consultant, or equivalent customer-facing role, including previous B2B SaaS experience.

  • Strategic Problem Solver: Possess deep technical proficiency to identify and validate technical, operational, and business pain points, driving clarity on solution requirements (Viable Solution Win).

  • Exceptional Communicator: Exhibit outstanding communication, storytelling, and active listening abilities, capable of delivering tailored, high-impact demonstrations that reinforce the sales narrative (Command of the Message).

  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Lead with empathy and curiosity, focusing on strategic discovery to uncover the why and urgency behind customer needs and tying every technical detail to measurable buyer impact (Desirable Solution Win).

  • Collaborative Deal Shaper: Work in lockstep with Account Executives on deal strategy, proactively strengthening qualification and guiding stakeholders toward alignment on a clear delivery path (Aligned Solution Win).

  • Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture.

  • Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills.

  • Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills.

  • Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus.

  • Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

You'll lead Vanta's EMEA Solutions Engineering team across the Growth and Commercial segments, developing a strong group of eight SEs while evolving our technical sales motion and helping drive growth in one of Vanta's highest-priority regions.

Solutions Engineering at Vanta sits at the intersection of product, technical, and sales. The SE team works alongside Account Executives to drive technical wins, lead discovery, and make the fit between customer needs and Vanta's capabilities real, converting qualified opportunities into closed revenue. In EMEA, that means operating across a wide and diverse market: from established financial and technology hubs across Western Europe to emerging opportunities across the Middle East, Israel, and Southern Europe, each with different regulatory contexts, GRC maturity levels, and buying behaviours. The team needs to show up credibly across all of them.

This manager leads the Growth and Commercial SE team, a group of eight SEs spanning a fast-moving, high-priority region. The SE motion is actively evolving from a repeatable demo approach toward a more consultative, value-based model in the right deals, while preserving speed and volume where that remains the right answer. The job is to develop the team and the motion together.

What you’ll do as a Manager, Solutions Engineering at Vanta:

  • Lead and develop the SE team: manage eight SEs across the Growth and Commercial segments, build on the existing operating rhythm, and establish a coaching cadence that elevates individual performance and team craft

  • Drive the evolution of the SE motion: work with your team and EMEA sales leadership to shift from a repeatable demo approach to a more consultative, value-based engagement model in the right deals, while maintaining speed and volume where that remains the right answer

  • Define what good technical engagement looks like: build and iterate on playbooks for discovery, demo quality, and POC approach that the team can replicate and refine as the motion matures

  • Strengthen the SE-AE partnership across EMEA: work closely with AE leadership to ensure SE contribution is well-integrated into the sales motion and coach SEs to show up as trusted technical advisors, not just demo operators

  • Lead AI adoption and modern tooling across the team: model hands-on AI use, identify where AI improves SE efficiency, and build team processes around it, coaching people through adoption rather than mandating it

  • Own team performance and reporting: track and improve key SE metrics including technical win rates, deal attachment, pipeline influence, and team capacity, and give leadership clear visibility into performance and investment priorities

  • Own the team's growth: partner with recruiting to define SE hiring profiles, play an active role in the interview process, and ensure new hires are set up to contribute to the team's direction and culture

How to be successful in this role:

  • Prior experience managing a Solutions Engineering team where people management (1:1s, performance conversations, hiring, team dynamics) is second nature, not something you're still working out; 3 to 5 years of SE management experience, with a total pre-sales or SE career of 7+ years

  • Experience leading a team through the shift from a volume-based SE motion to a more consultative, value-based approach, including knowing when to preserve speed and demo-forward execution

  • Genuine AI and modern tooling fluency: hands-on use in your own workflow and a track record of building team processes around AI tools, not just awareness of them

  • EMEA market experience, including an understanding of the region's diversity in language, geography, GRC and compliance maturity, and how buyers across different markets approach security decisions

  • Familiarity with GRC, compliance, or security SaaS; GDPR fluency is a meaningful plus

  • Experience at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company where you've built processes that didn't exist before, without needing mature-org infrastructure to operate effectively

  • Based in London, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in office)

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Account Executive, Early Stage
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We're scaling our Early Stage Sales team with customer-focused Account Executives who will take ownership of their entire sales cycle and distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

Vanta is growing quickly, we're profitable, and we're continually outpacing our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores. Our Sales team is leading the charge in exceeding our revenue goals and growing our market share as the industry leader in compliance and security.

 

If this sounds like you, and you're excited to join a growing sales team, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as a Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on expediting deals within a 30-day timeframe.

  • Turn our inbound demand into closed-new business and happy Vanta customers.

  • Manage our sales pipeline, improving and maturing our sales process and playbook.

  • Define and communicate the specific benefits of Vanta appropriate for each customer, including making sales materials and demos.

  • Collect insights from prospects for our product development process.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role 2+ years, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB with a focus on short deal cycles.

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

What you can expect as a Vanta'n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Enable AI tooling with semantic layers and observability, guiding analytics functions on best practices.

  • Have a passion for enabling the developer experience of data, and being obsessed with giving data super powers across the company.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Technical Support Engineer (TSE), you’ll play a critical role in supporting our customers by resolving their most complex technical issues and serving as the final technical escalation point for our Technical Support Specialists (TSS). You’ll collaborate closely with our Support and Engineering teams to ensure we deliver a best-in-class customer experience while meeting our service SLAs.

Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. Our team’s mission: “We make complex solutions seem simple, and are leaders in customer education”. We build strong partnerships with our customers through trust and transparency, for this reason our Technical Support Metrics are available publicly.

What you’ll do as a Technical Support Engineer at Vanta:

  • Provide technical support to Vanta customers through email, screen sharing, and chat, responding within established SLAs.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Vanta’s product capabilities, integrations, configurations, messaging, and more.

  • Own and resolve complex technical customers’ issues, while also partnering with Technical Support Specialists (TSS) on their most challenging cases as the final technical escalation point within the Support team.

  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and accountability for the overall customer experience.

  • Clearly explain complex solutions to customers and document them for future use.

  • Problem-solve and troubleshoot in a repeatable manner, documenting in our Support CRM to help identify trends.

  • Create reproducible test cases and collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve the platform.

  • Validate and escalate bugs to Engineering, keeping customers updated on progress.

  • Contribute to internal and customer-facing documentation, as well as process and workflow improvements.

  • Actively participate in daily troubleshooting sessions, weekly team meetings, and other team activities.

  • Act as the trusted technical point of contact for assigned Premium Support customers, delivering high-touch, white-glove support and ensuring adherence to enhanced SLA requirements.

  • Proactively share knowledge with the broader team during knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 4+ years of technical support experience in a SaaS/Tech environment.

  • 2+ years in a Tier 3 or Tier 4 (highest tier) technical support role.

  • Experience supporting Premium Support customers

  • Located in Ireland and able to support an 8 AM–5 PM Irish Standard Time schedule, with rotating on-call responsibilities (including rotational weekends and holidays).

  • Willingness to work on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of 2 days per week in office.

  • Strong troubleshooting experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)—including monitoring, load balancers, tagging, etc.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and cloud application architecture.

  • Solid understanding of APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and networking fundamentals.

  • Familiar with relational databases (SQL) and document databases (NoSQL, MongoDB)

  • Familiar with IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth, SCIM) and Identity Providers (Okta, Auth0, O365)

  • Experience using tools like Datadog or similar log management platforms.

  • Proficient in troubleshooting databases and analyzing complex, multi-relational data sourced via APIs.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal—you can simplify technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to write clear, concise documentation and knowledge base content.

  • Comfortable presenting technical topics to a variety of audiences.

  • A strong sense of empathy—for your customers and your teammates.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits, including bike to work scheme and tax commuter ticket scheme

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year

  • 11 company-paid holidaysVirtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Systems Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Corporate Engineering team is the infrastructure layer that keeps 1,500+ people connected, secure, and moving fast. This role leads the shift from a reactive support function to a platform function the whole company relies on.

Corporate Engineering owns the systems, tooling, and access infrastructure Vanta runs on. From identity and device management to AI tooling infrastructure and ITSM, CE makes sure Vanta's people have the right access, the right tools, and the right guardrails on day one and every day after.

CE is at an inflection point. The company has scaled quickly, AI tooling is live company-wide, and the team is ready for a leader who sets technical direction, establishes clear ownership, and builds the leadership layer beneath them.

As Sr. Manager, Systems Engineering, you will lead a team of experienced engineers, own several of the company's highest-priority platform initiatives, and make CE a function the rest of Vanta builds on rather than routes around.

What you’ll do as a Senior Manager, Systems Engineering at Vanta:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of systems engineers and a tech lead. Set clear expectations, hold a high bar, and develop the people who build Vanta's most critical internal systems.

  • Own joiner, mover, and leaver automation end to end in Okta Workflows, so access is correct on day one, follows people through role changes, and closes completely on departure, including API keys and service credentials.

  • Build and own device assurance across macOS and Windows, defining OS, browser, and device-state policy ahead of enforcement rather than in response to it.

  • Rationalize the ITSM estate so self-service works, engineers spend their time on platform work instead of tool administration, and partner teams have a system they trust.

  • Make Corporate Engineering a governed step in SaaS procurement, with SSO enforced, access reviewed, and no tools discovered months after they went live.

  • Own the identity, access, and connector infrastructure behind Vanta's company-wide AI stack, including MCP servers and the Vercel platform, in close partnership with our AI and Data teams.

  • Build the visibility layer that shows how work enters the team and where capacity goes, so priorities are set with data and tradeoffs are legible to partners.

  • Partner with Security, GRC, Finance, and Engineering to enable rather than gate, building guardrails that make self-service safe instead of controls that slow the company down.

How to be successful in this role:

  • A track record of raising the bar on an inherited team, holding it through sustained one-on-one coaching, and staying steady when the results take more than a quarter to show.

  • Real appetite for inherited complexity, whether that is an orphaned endpoint program, an unfinished migration, or an over-engineered workflow. Interest in untangling it, not just tolerance for it.

  • An enablement-first instinct. Your default question is how to make something safe to self-serve, not how to control it.

  • Enough technical depth to evaluate estimates honestly and tell the difference between genuine risk and reported progress.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI in enterprise tooling, including deploying or governing AI-assisted automation in platforms such as Okta, Intune, Jamf, Atlassian, or GitHub.

  • Experience spanning identity, endpoint, ITSM, and procurement, or deep expertise in most of them with a track record of expanding scope.

  • Comfort operating through influence. Several levers this role depends on, including security policy, procurement, and AI strategy, sit in partner organizations.

  • 8+ years in IT or systems engineering, including 3+ years managing and developing engineers, ideally at a company that scaled through a significant headcount inflection.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

 - Make Corporate Engineering a governed step in SaaS procurement, with SSO enforced, access reviewed, and no tools discovered months after they went live.

 - Own the identity, access, and connector infrastructure behind Vanta's company-wide AI stack, including MCP servers and the Vercel platform, in close partnership with our AI and Data teams.

 - Build the visibility layer that shows how work enters the team and where capacity goes, so priorities are set with data and tradeoffs are legible to partners.

 - Partner with Security, GRC, Finance, and Engineering to enable rather than gate, building guardrails that make self-service safe instead of controls that slow the company down.



How to be successful in this role:

 - A track record of raising the bar on an inherited team, holding it through sustained one-on-one coaching, and staying steady when the results take more than a quarter to show.

 - Real appetite for inherited complexity, whether that is an orphaned endpoint program, an unfinished migration, or an over-engineered workflow. Interest in untangling it, not just tolerance for it.

 - An enablement-first instinct. Your default question is how to make something safe to self-serve, not how to control it.

 - Enough technical depth to evaluate estimates honestly and tell the difference between genuine risk and reported progress.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI in enterprise tooling, including deploying or governing AI-assisted automation in platforms such as Okta, Intune, Jamf, Atlassian, or GitHub.

 - Experience spanning identity, endpoint, ITSM, and procurement, or deep expertise in most of them with a track record of expanding scope.

 - Comfort operating through influence. Several levers this role depends on, including security policy, procurement, and AI strategy, sit in partner organizations.

 - 8+ years in IT or systems engineering, including 3+ years managing and developing engineers, ideally at a company that scaled through a significant headcount inflection.

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The team owns top-of-funnel strategy and operations for the Upmarket Sales organization, supporting both AEs and SDRs. We shape and operate how leads and accounts are deployed across the field through lead routing and management, AE account pairing, territory management, and account assignment strategy.

This role sits at the center of how our Upmarket Sales organization goes to market and creates pipeline. You’ll own both the day-to-day operations and the evolution of our Top-of-Funnel processes—working hands-on in the details while shaping the strategy for how we deploy AEs and SDRs. Your work will ensure the right coverage, processes, and workflows are in place to improve pipeline generation, seller productivity, and the overall efficiency of our GTM motion.

What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the day-to-day execution of Top-of-Funnel operations, including responding to field requests and managing the processes, data, systems, and business logic underlying lead-to-account, territory, and AE coverage decisions. This is a hands-on role that balances ongoing operational needs with larger strategic initiatives and process improvements.

  • Own territory strategy and ongoing territory management, ensuring AEs and SDRs have high-quality, balanced coverage and identifying opportunities to improve how accounts and selling capacity are deployed.

  • Design and optimize AE coverage and account pairing strategies to improve how our sellers work together to generate and progress pipeline.

  • Identify and lead Top-of-Funnel initiatives that improve pipeline coverage, territory quality, seller productivity, and GTM efficiency.

  • Dig into data, systems, processes, and field feedback to identify root causes of GTM challenges and develop a point of view on what we should do differently.

  • Lead initiatives end-to-end—from problem definition and analysis through recommendation, stakeholder alignment, implementation, and measurement of results.

  • Partner closely with AEs, SDRs, and Sales leadership to understand field needs and translate them into scalable improvements across workflows, processes, tooling, territories, and accountability.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing Operations, GTM Systems, Analytics, and other GTM teams to design and operationalize solutions that work across the broader GTM ecosystem.

  • Serve as a trusted SME for Upmarket lead-to-account and Top-of-Funnel operations, bringing a strong point of view while continuously evolving our operating model as the business scales.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related function, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • Deep experience with Top-of-Funnel and lead-to-account operations, including areas such as lead routing, account assignment, territory management, seller coverage, and AE operating models.

  • An investigative mindset with a demonstrated ability to dig beneath surface-level symptoms, connect insights across data, systems, processes, and field feedback, and identify the root cause of complex GTM problems.

  • A hands-on operating style. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves, getting into the weeds, and doing the detailed work required to turn a strategy or recommendation into something that works in practice.

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to understand complex GTM mechanics while anticipating dependencies, edge cases, and downstream impacts.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to combine quantitative and qualitative insights, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop a clear point of view even when there isn’t an obvious answer.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable business impact.

  • Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with everyone from AEs and SDRs in the field to Sales leadership and partners across GTM.

  • A business-partner mindset: you listen closely to stakeholders and understand their needs while bringing your own expertise, judgment, and willingness to respectfully challenge the proposed solution when there is a better path forward.

  • Ability to move fluidly between strategic thinking and detailed execution—helping shape where we should go while being equally comfortable building the processes required to get there.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing or related field.

jobs.title: Head of Internal Communications
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta's Internal Communications Director, you'll help set the internal beat of the company making sure every team member understands the messages that matter, while also defining how we communicate with each other as we scale

The People team builds the systems, culture, and experience that let Vanta'ns do their best work as we grow quickly across the globe. Internal comms sits at the heart of that mission: making sure every Vanta'n understands our strategy, our story, and what's expected of them, no matter how fast we're moving.

Reporting to the Head of People, this is a build-from-scratch mandate. You'll define the strategy, the infrastructure, and the cadence for how Vanta communicates. You'll have room to bring your own voice and instincts into how we do it, from the words we choose for a key company moment to how an all-hands actually feels in the room. Then you'll roll up your sleeves to make it happen.

What you’ll do as an Internal Communications Director at Vanta:

  • Shape how Vanta tells its own story internally and ensure that key messages land at exactly the right moment.

  • Build and manage internal comms infrastructure: the channels, cadences and best practices for how the company communicates (Slack norms, docs, wikis, etc.).

  • Own key internal company-wide moments end to end, including all-hands, major announcements, and org-wide notifications, from planning through delivery.

  • Partner closely with the People team as a strategic sounding board on sensitive or high-stakes communications

  • Serve as a strategic communications partner across the business, triaging and prioritizing company-wide communication requests and partnering with stakeholders to translate complex topics into clear, effective messaging.

  • Partner with Marketing and External Comms to keep our internal and external narrative aligned and consistent.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the C-team and Leadership Team on how and when to communicate major business updates.

  • Build and protect company culture and morale through comms, keeping the energy and momentum visible as Vanta grows.

  • Evolve Vanta's internal comms strategy and toolkit as the company scales, experimenting with new formats and channels.

  • Measure and iterate on what's working, bringing a data-informed lens to internal comms.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8-10+ years of experience building and running an internal comms strategy, ideally at a high-growth company.

  • Proven track record on building an internal comms strategy and executing on that strategy

  • Strong writer and storyteller who can translate complex or sensitive topics into clear, human messaging.

  • Comfortable operating at both altitudes. Can set strategy but is equally willing to execute (write the email, run the all-hands, edit the deck).

  • Executive influence and partnership. Able to partner with and influence the C-team and Leadership Team.

  • Experience partnering with People/HR teams on sensitive organizational communications.

  • Excellent judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance competing communication requests, advise stakeholders on what requires company-wide visibility.

  • A natural sense for culture and energy. Someone who brings personality and vibes, not just polished corporate messaging.

  • Creative and willing to take risks and try new things. Comfortable pitching bold or unconventional ideas, and knows how to calibrate when to push and when to dial it back.

  • Leverage AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Data and Analytics team is currently looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us!

You’ll be responsible for laying the foundation for a best-in-class business analytics function. You’ll partner closely with our business stakeholders to ensure that our analytics stack and processes meet the business needs today with an eye towards the future.

What you’ll do as a Senior Data Scientist at Vanta:

  • Build and maintain trusted product data assets using dbt, Snowflake, and modern analytics infrastructure

  • Leverage AI-powered analytics tools and data agents (e.g., Snowflake Cortex) to accelerate insight generation, automate repeatable analysis, and scale decision-making

  • Define and evolve measurement frameworks for product health, customer lifecycle, and AI-powered product experiences

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success to influence product strategy through data

  • Help define Vanta’s analytics strategy and AI measurement practices as our product and data platform evolve

Vanta’s Security Operations team provides essential security operational services, including configuring, monitoring, and maintaining our security tools and infrastructure.   • Leverage AI to improve efficiency of team processes, and improve the maturity of the overall security program.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Customers increasingly use AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and internal Slack agents to run their business processes, and security and compliance work is no exception. For those agents to do that work, they need access to Vanta’s trust graph and intelligence layer. Vanta is building for that world: security and compliance products that customers can use through Vanta, through third-party agent platforms, and inside their own internal tools.

As Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem, you will own Vanta’s external agent surfaces: MCP, CLI, and plugins in marketplaces like Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT. Your job is to make Vanta the trusted compliance layer that agents rely on. You will define the strategy, ship the products, and own the outcomes.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta’s agent ecosystem products.

  • Define how agents discover, access, and safely use Vanta capabilities, partnering with the platform teams that own APIs and authentication.

  • Hold outcome parity as a product principle: work a customer can complete in Vanta should be possible through MCP, CLI, and plugin surfaces too.

  • Lead marketplace and plugin launches, aligning product, engineering, legal, security, and go-to-market around each one.

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship secure, reliable developer products.

  • Build the developer-facing marketing motion: external agent documentation and customer stories that show what MCP and CLI users have unlocked.

  • Partner with the product partnerships and alliances team on co-marketing with agent platforms like Anthropic and OpenAI, keeping a pulse on the agent ecosystem so Vanta is part of the key stacks.

  • Define adoption and quality metrics, and use customer and product data to prioritize.

  • Experience shipping developer-facing or programmatic products (APIs, integrations, plugins, SDKs, or CLI tools), and comfort treating MCP, CLI, and plugins as product surfaces.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, authentication, and developer tools. Hands-on experience building with AI and agent tools, not just evaluating them.

jobs.title: Product GRC Subject Matter Expert, (V4G)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta for Government (V4G) is how we bring that mission to the public sector. As federal compliance undergoes its biggest shift in a decade — FedRAMP 20x, machine-readable authorization, OSCAL — we're building the platform that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. The GRC Subject Matter Experts on this team are the people who make that possible.

As Vanta's GRC Subject Matter Expert for V4G, you'll own federal compliance content used by every customer pursuing or maintaining federal authorization on our platform. This is an interpretation-and-authoring role, not a compliance program administration role: your job is to interpret underlying control requirements, identify where FedRAMP modifies or constrains the NIST framework, and translate those interpretations into precise, technically testable guidance that engineering can build and customers can act on. The content you write ships as product — a five-person startup and a Fortune 100 CSP both receive it — so calibrating depth, precision, and universality is the core craft.

You'll join Vanta's Security organization, which directly influences product development, facilitates the creation of automated GRC solutions for customers, and provides expert advisory services across the company.

What you’ll do as a V4G GRC SME at Vanta:

  • Build and own federal compliance frameworks — Lead the creation, enhancement, and lifecycle management of controls, evidence requirements, and implementation guidance for FedRAMP (Low/Moderate/High), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, DFARS, and StateRAMP. Author clear control rationales, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing guidance shipped as out-of-the-box product content.

  • Interpret controls at the mechanics level — Work fluently with 800-53A assessment procedures and 800-53B baselines; resolve organization-defined parameters and FedRAMP's constraints on them; decompose controls into distinct technical obligations; correctly resolve inherited, shared, and customer-owned responsibilities within a customer responsibility matrix; and anchor evidence expectations in authoritative artifacts (PPSM, STIG and CIS hardening standards and their scan outputs across operating systems, databases, network devices, and endpoints).

  • Author automated tests & continuous monitoring — Translate controls and infrastructure context (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP, SaaS, endpoints, CI/CD) into spec-level automated tests and detectors. Define test logic, data sources, edge cases, and — critically — failure conditions: how unapproved items, exceptions, missing data, and unevaluated resources affect a result. Pair with Engineering to implement and maintain detectors with versioned framework mappings.

You will build the layer that makes Vanta's data actually useful: a single interpretive layer that reads across every source of truth and makes them queryable, reasoned-over, and genuinely illuminating — for EPD, for GTM, and for anyone in the org trying to understand what's happening and why.

The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself. We're constructing three interlocking layers: sources of truth at the foundation, an operating system that makes delivery legible, and the intelligence layer that reasons across all of it. This role owns the intelligence layer — the one that doesn't exist yet.

This is a builder role. You will ship working things yourself — prototypes, internal tools, agent workflows. You will not hand specs to someone else and wait. Communication isn't a separate deliverable; it's how you learn what to build.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Builder at Vanta:

  • Build the intelligence layer: a cross-source interpretive layer that reads across Vanta's sources of truth and makes them queryable and reasoned-over by EPD leadership, GTM, and beyond

  • Define what to build: scope the problem yourself, make explicit tradeoffs about what to defer, and own the sequence of what gets built and when

  • Ship working things yourself: prototypes, internal tools, agent workflows — using AI as part of how you work, not what you report on

  • Understand the organization: go to the teams whose decisions this layer will serve — GTM, G&A, EPD — and come back knowing what they can't answer today

  • Catch and address AI-specific quality problems — reliability, cost, latency, drift, bad answers — before they cause damage

  • Build on top of what the Signal Collection and EPD OS roles are constructing; understand what's trustworthy and what's coming

How to be successful in this role:

  • You scope ambiguous problems yourself — you don't wait for the mandate to sharpen before you start. You're comfortable showing unpolished work, and you're honest about when to push ahead alone vs. pull in an engineer

  • We use AI to augment our own capabilities and invest deeply in helping every Vantan enhance their work through AI

You will build the operating system for EPD — the systems, agents, and practices that make engineering, product, and design unreasonably effective at delivery, with Jira as the substrate.



The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself and operate well. We're constructing three interlocking layers: sources of truth at the foundation, a shared interpretive layer that reasons across all of them, and the operating system that makes the work itself legible. This role owns the operating system.



This is not a traditional PMO or status-reporting role. You build — agents, automation, workflow design, and the practices that make teams want to use the system rather than route around it.



What you’ll do as a Senior Systems Designer at Vanta:

 - Design and own workflow and hierarchy across engineering, product, and design in Jira

 - Make sure Jira reflects real practice, and real practice reflects what needs to show up in Jira — in both directions

 - Build the agents and automation that run the system yourself, with AI as part of how you work

 - Drive adoption: go to the teams whose practice doesn't match the substrate today and change that — through conversation, well-built artifacts, or clear instruction that works without you in the room

 - Understand delivery breakdowns at the mechanism level and build fixes that address the root cause, not the symptom

 - Build alongside teammates who are growing into more technical work — raise their ceiling, not just your own output



How to be successful in this role:

 - You build and ship, recently, with AI as part of how you work. "I'd ask an engineer to build that" is not a valid answer here

 - You find the mechanism that's actually failing before you reach for a tool. Your default is to remove steps, not add them

 - You move toward a solution now. You don't wait for a green light to start, and you can name a real decision you made and acted on without checking first

 - You learn what's new before anyone tells you to — especially in AI tooling — and you share what you find with others

 - You get things adopted without authority: through a conversation, a well-built artifact, or clear instruction that carries your message beyond you being in the room

 - You're accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact. The real work often happens after launch — adoption, fixing wrong assumptions, cleanup after handoff — and you do that work yourself

 - We use AI to augment our own capabilities and invest deeply in helping every Vantan enhance their work through AI

 - No CS degree required, no formal engineering tenure required. Real, recent, shipped work is what clears the bar

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Evaluation Engine
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Senior Software Engineers independently drive complex technical work, shape the systems and technical decisions within their teams, and enable other engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.

Vanta's product monitors the security posture of thousands of companies, pulling tens of millions of API calls of data per day, pushing information from hundreds of thousands of laptop agents, and running tests against that data continuously to identify potential security threats. Our infrastructure and tooling need to stay ahead of exponential growth in our customer base. As a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta, you'll drive complex projects across our technical stack, contribute to the technical direction of your team, and mentor other engineers. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta's growth.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

Tests are at the heart of how Vanta continuously monitors security and compliance for our customers. The Evaluation Engine team builds the runtime platform that powers these checks. We own how Tests are scheduled and executed, how their results are persisted and exposed, and the systems that keep this runtime reliable as Vanta grows.

In this role, you'll work on some of the core systems behind Vanta's Tests platform. You'll tackle problems around the reliability, correctness, and performance of Test execution, evolve the systems and abstractions that allow the platform to scale, and make it easier for other engineering teams to build on the Tests runtime. Many of these problems span multiple systems and teams and require a deep understanding of how the platform behaves in production.

What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer on the Evaluation Engine team at Vanta:

  • Own complex projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and operation

  • Design and evolve the backend systems, APIs, and data models used to run Tests and process their results

  • Improve the reliability, correctness, performance, and observability of the Tests runtime

  • Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and build durable solutions

  • Simplify existing systems and improve the abstractions and interfaces that other engineers build on

  • Collaborate with engineers across Vanta on problems that span systems and team boundaries

  • Give thoughtful feedback in design and code reviews, communicate technical tradeoffs, and help other engineers make good decisions

  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the engineering culture of the team

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have strong experience building and operating reliable, scalable backend systems in production

  • Have independently delivered complex technical projects where the problem or solution was not always well defined

  • Have strong systems thinking and fundamentals in backend system design, APIs, and data modeling

  • Be a strong debugger who can reason about correctness, reliability, performance, and scalability across complex systems

  • Make effective technical tradeoffs, take ownership of systems in production, and improve mature systems incrementally

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly, give thoughtful feedback on designs, and collaborate effectively with engineers across teams

  • Experience with TypeScript, GraphQL, MongoDB, and observability tools such as Datadog is a plus

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

  • Physical location: you must reside in, and perform all work exclusively from within, the United States, accessing systems only from U.S. locations.

  • Work Authorization Requirements: You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.

As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.

 
 

What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:

  • Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

  • Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.

  • Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.

  • Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.

  • Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.

  • Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.

  • Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.

  • Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.

  • Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.

  • Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.

  • Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.

  • Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • 4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.

  • A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.

  • Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.

  • A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.

  • Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.

  • Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
