jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead - EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

  • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

  • Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

  • Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

  • Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

  • Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

  • Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

  • Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

  • Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

  • Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

  • Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience

  • Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users

  • Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others

  • Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Design Systems team creates the visual and interaction foundations that help Vanta deliver coherent, accessible, and high-quality experiences across the product. This team partners across the EPD organization to build the systems, patterns, and practices that enable product teams to move faster while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability.

As a Staff Visual Product Designer focused on Design Systems at Vanta, you will shape the visual language of our product and the systems that bring it to life. You will define and evolve scalable patterns across our design and engineering ecosystems, partner closely with product designers and engineers, and help create a cohesive experience for customers navigating complex security and compliance workflows. You’ll combine exceptional visual craft with systems thinking, product judgment, and the ability to influence across teams.

What you’ll do as a Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems at Vanta:

  • Define and evolve Vanta’s visual design language across product surfaces, creating a cohesive, distinctive, and scalable customer experience.

  • Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, and interaction details.

  • Partner with Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and Brand teams to translate customer and business needs into effective system-level solutions.

  • Own and evolve foundational design system elements, including design tokens, component visual states, responsive behavior, theming, density, and platform-specific adaptations.

  • Create reusable patterns and guidance that help product teams solve common problems consistently while preserving flexibility for different customer workflows.

  • Design and prototype system components and end-to-end product experiences, using high-fidelity exploration to communicate intent and accelerate alignment.

  • Bring visual clarity and hierarchy to complex, data-rich workflows used by security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented with fidelity, accessibility, performance, and maintainability in mind.

  • Establish principles, standards, and review practices that raise the quality and consistency of product design across Vanta.

  • Advocate for inclusive and accessible visual design, ensuring that color, contrast, typography, motion, and interaction states work for a broad range of users and contexts.

  • Help define how the design system supports emerging product needs, including AI-powered experiences, personalization, automation, and increasingly complex enterprise workflows.

  • Use customer insights, product data, usability feedback, and competitive research to identify opportunities to improve the system and its impact.

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

  • Facilitate critiques, workshops, and cross-functional reviews that help teams make stronger visual and product decisions.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, compelling narratives, prototypes, and a clear point of view.

  • Mentor product designers and contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, experimentation, and customer obsession.

  • Create documentation, examples, and enablement materials that make the design system easy to understand, adopt, and extend.

  • Define and measure the impact of the design system through adoption, consistency, accessibility, usability, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.

  • Represent Design Systems in planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums, helping teams align around a shared vision for the Vanta experience.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, strengthening design craft, and improving how Vanta approaches visual product quality.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience designing digital products, with significant experience in visual product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • Deep expertise in visual design for digital products, including typography, color, composition, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, interaction states, and data visualization.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, thoughtful systems thinking, and the ability to improve product experiences at both the component and end-to-end workflow level.

  • Experience creating, evolving, and scaling product design systems used by multiple teams across a growing organization.

  • Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and the relationship between design tools and front-end implementation.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous product and customer problems into clear, elegant, and reusable visual solutions.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineers to bring detailed visual designs to life and to make pragmatic decisions when implementation constraints arise.

  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to understand customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and the broader relationships among product surfaces and workflows.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience balancing consistency and flexibility, knowing when to use an existing pattern, when to extend it, and when to introduce something new.

  • A demonstrated ability to give and receive thoughtful feedback, mentor others, and raise the quality bar across a design organization.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • Experience designing products in cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Experience with tools such as Figma and familiarity with front-end technologies or design system implementation workflows is a plus.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how you operate and deliver results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security.  - Define and measure the impact of the design system through adoption, consistency, accessibility, usability, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.

 - Represent Design Systems in planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums, helping teams align around a shared vision for the Vanta experience.

 - Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, strengthening design craft, and improving how Vanta approaches visual product quality.
   
   

How to be successful in this role:

 - 8+ years of experience designing digital products, with significant experience in visual product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

 - Deep expertise in visual design for digital products, including typography, color, composition, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, interaction states, and data visualization.

 - A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, thoughtful systems thinking, and the ability to improve product experiences at both the component and end-to-end workflow level.

 - Experience creating, evolving, and scaling product design systems used by multiple teams across a growing organization.

 - Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and the relationship between design tools and front-end implementation.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous product and customer problems into clear, elegant, and reusable visual solutions.

 - Experience partnering closely with engineers to bring detailed visual designs to life and to make pragmatic decisions when implementation constraints arise.

 - Strong product thinking, with the ability to understand customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and the broader relationships among product surfaces and workflows.

 - Excellent communication, storytelling, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying on formal authority.

 - Experience balancing consistency and flexibility, knowing when to use an existing pattern, when to extend it, and when to introduce something new.

 - A demonstrated ability to give and receive thoughtful feedback, mentor others, and raise the quality bar across a design organization.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

 - Experience designing products in cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

 - Experience with tools such as Figma and familiarity with front-end technologies or design system implementation workflows is a plus.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Vanta for Government team, you'll set the technical foundation for Vanta's expansion into the public sector: designing the systems, patterns, and architecture that will power compliance programs from the ground up for government vendors and agencies.

The Vanta for Government team is building and evolving Vanta's AI-powered platform for government vendors, federal agencies, and State, Local, and Education (SLED) organizations. Our mission is to make government compliance not easy, but easier: helping organizations automate the heavy lifting across complex frameworks like FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST, strengthen their security posture, and support mission-critical work with greater confidence.

You’ll work directly alongside early design partners to shape new capabilities in real time. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to deliver significant impact to our government product line, designing systems that adapt Vanta's core compliance platform to meet the demands of federal agencies, government vendors, and SLED organizations

  • Lead the design and build of net-new product capabilities — including core compliance workflow features that don't yet exist in Vanta's product today — working alongside early design partners to validate and iterate as requirements evolve

  • Partner with adjacent engineering teams on shared infrastructure and tagging systems that underpin government-specific compliance workflows, building on existing platform investments rather than starting from scratch

  • Drive technical initiatives across engineering, product, and go-to-market, translating ambiguous early-stage requirements into durable, scalable solutions

  • Contribute to building Vanta’s engineering culture as we grow

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of industry experience

  • Strong systems thinking and platform architecture skills: you design for reuse, scalability, and long-term maintainability, and naturally think in terms of abstractions and patterns

  • Experience in highly regulated industries such as fintech or healthcare; FedRAMP or government domain experience is a plus, but not required

  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, 0→1 environments where requirements evolve as you learn from customers and technical decisions carry real business consequences

  • A strong product mindset: you understand that shipping matters, can prioritize against real deadlines, and balance technical rigor with delivery velocity

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

jobs.title: Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager, Mid-Late Sales Funnel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The team owns the operational strategy and execution of our mid-to-late GTM Sales motion for the NAMER Upmarket organization, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. We build and evolve the sales processes, workflows, data, and policies that enable sellers to effectively manage opportunities, navigate complex deals, and convert pipeline into predictable revenue.

Our work spans opportunity management, forecasting, complex deal strategy and structuring, contracting workflows, and Rules of Engagement. We work hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate critical deals and day-to-day business challenges, while identifying where broader processes, policies, data, or systems need to evolve. We partner closely across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other GTM teams to improve seller effectiveness, sales efficiency, conversion, and revenue predictability as the business scales.

What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and day to day operations for the Upmarket mid-to-late sales funnel, shaping how opportunities progress from creation through close. Develop a strong point of view on the sales processes, stage management, opportunity management, workflows, and seller behaviors needed to improve conversion, sales efficiency, and predictable revenue growth.

  • Own and evolve the operational workflows and data that support contracting and complex deal execution, ensuring sellers have clear, scalable paths from opportunity through contract and close. Serve as a go-to strategic and operational partner for creative and complex deal structures, working hands-on with sellers and Sales leadership to navigate non-standard scenarios while partnering closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Use insights from individual deals to identify recurring friction and drive improvements to the processes, policies, data, and systems that enable the business to close effectively at scale.

  • Shape deal strategy and the operational processes that support complex sales motions, partnering with sellers, Sales leadership, Deal Desk, Finance, and other teams to navigate complex opportunities while identifying where broader process, policy, or system changes can make it easier and more effective to close business at scale.

  • Evolve the Rules of Engagement and the cross-functional policies that govern how GTM teams work together throughout the sales cycle, bringing clarity to ownership, handoffs, deal scenarios, and areas of competing priorities. Lead alignment across Sales and other GTM organizations as our sales motions and business needs evolve.

  • Own and evolve sales forecast cadences, facilitating forecast reviews with Sales leadership to scrutinize pipeline health and deal-specific risks.

  • Identify and lead strategic improvements to our mid-to-late funnel operating model, using data, field insights, and deep sales process expertise to diagnose where opportunities are getting stuck or where seller effectiveness can improve. Lead complex initiatives from problem definition and recommendation through senior stakeholder alignment, hands-on implementation, and measurement of business impact in partnership with GTM Systems & Analytics and other cross-functional teams.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 12+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, or a related function within B2B SaaS, with significant experience supporting complex Upmarket sales motions.

  • Mid to late funnel GTM experience and opportunity-to-close processes across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise. You understand opportunity management, sales stages and methodology, forecasting, pipeline health, complex buying cycles, and how decisions throughout the funnel impact revenue outcomes.

  • Strong experience with complex deal strategy and Deal Desk, including pricing and approvals, contracting workflows, non-standard deal structures, and complex commercial scenarios. You’re comfortable getting into the details of an individual opportunity and partnering with sellers to develop creative paths to close while balancing the broader needs of the business.

  • A hands-on operating style with the ability to move fluidly between setting direction and getting into the weeds across opportunities, data, account and opportunity hierarchies, systems, processes, and seller workflows. You’re naturally investigative, able to identify root causes and patterns, and turn what you learn into scalable improvements.

  • Strong business judgment and a clear point of view. You combine data, GTM expertise, and field context to make recommendations in ambiguous situations, evaluate tradeoffs and downstream implications, and advocate for a direction while remaining open to new information.

  • Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functionally, from frontline sellers to senior Sales and GTM leadership. You can build alignment across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, GTM Systems & Analytics, and other partners, navigate competing priorities, and challenge constructively without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience serving as a trusted partner to senior Sales leadership—understanding the needs of the business, bringing a point of view on what should change, and staying close enough to the work to help drive outcomes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work—demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

  • Raise the written design bar: drive RFCs and decision records that make architectural decisions durable and shared across the team.

  • Act as a force multiplier: mentor engineers up to your own level, expand the team's review capacity, and partner with your EM on team health and culture.

  • Build with TypeScript and Node.js on the backend, contribute to customer-facing experiences in React, and use AI tools to accelerate development and workflows.

  • Experience rolling out or deprecating major systems safely at scale.

  • Strong written design communication and demonstrated mentorship; you multiply the engineers around you.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Bonus: startup or bias-for-action environments, MongoDB at scale, prior work in security or compliance products.

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's V4G Partnerships function sits at the intersection of our platform, the government agencies and contractors we serve, and the broad network of systems integrators, resellers, service providers, and auditors within the public sector compliance and risk management ecosystem. You'll help build and grow these partnerships to build pipeline, as well as to ensure that customers have access to high-quality, trusted delivery through Vanta.

As Director, Vanta for Government (V4G) Partnerships, you will own Vanta's partner function for the public sector — the strategy, the network, and the programs that let it scale — supporting both our government sales motion (Federal and SLED) and our government vendor business. Reporting directly to the Head of Public Sector, you will define the partner archetypes, tiering, and coverage model required to serve government demand, and own V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR that rolls into Vanta's overall partner-sourced target. You'll work in close partnership with the VP of Global Channel & Alliances, who owns that overall target and channel operating model, to ensure the public sector motion is built on — and strengthens — that foundation. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for someone who has built a public sector partner function from the ground up: designing joint GTM programs, negotiating enterprise partnership agreements, and standing up the mechanisms that let a partner network scale beyond the person running it.

You'll have meaningful scope: you'll own the V4G partner function — the strategy, the partner network, the program design, and the team — and decide how Vanta invests across public sector partners, including tiering, enablement investment, and where to expand or exit. You'll own the V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR contribution, and the coverage standard that determines how partner resources are leveraged and applied across Vanta’s government and commercial opportunities.You'll start with one partnerships manager and build the team as the segment grows, taking a “player-coach” approach to help establish that growth.

  • Own the V4G partner strategy across Federal and SLED — define the partner archetypes Vanta needs (resellers, service partners, GSIs, 3PAOs and C3PAOs), the tiering and coverage model, and the multi-year plan to build a network that meets government and commercial demand.

  • Own the V4G partner-sourced pipeline and ARR contribution to Vanta's partner-sourced target, and define the metrics by which public sector partner performance, partner health, and network coverage are measured — including the coverage standard for FedRAMP and CMMC delivery capacity.

  • Design the programs and mechanisms that let the network scale — partner tiering and certification, enablement paths, co-sell motion, MDF and investment allocation, partner health frameworks, and standardized partner agreements built with Legal.

  • Build and lead the V4G partnerships team, starting with one manager and scaling with the segment. Set the operating rhythms, quality bar, and performance standards, and develop the team to own partner relationships directly.

  • Partner with the VP of Global Channel & Alliances and the broader channel organization to extend the V4G motion across Vanta's full partner ecosystem — including MSPs, VARs, and auditors working on federal compliance programs like FedRAMP and CMMC — ensuring the public sector motion strengthens rather than duplicates the commercial one.

  • Serve as the voice of the government ecosystem inside Vanta, with a influence in V4G product roadmap, packaging, and pricing decisions — translating what partners, commercial customers, and government agencies need into a prioritized point of view Product and Engineering can act on.

  • Expand the network and reduce concentration risk by identifying and onboarding new firms, capturing demand from large partners not yet engaged, and making clear calls about where Vanta invests and where it walks away.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience managing public sector channel and/or partnerships, with a strong network across GSIs, managed service providers, resellers, and auditors.

  • Deep familiarity with the public sector ecosystem, including Federal and SLED go-to-market motions and federal compliance programs, such as FedRAMP and CMMC.

  • 5+ years of people management experience, including managing performance across a team.

  • Experience owning a revenue target delivered through partners, including defining the metrics and operating cadence required to hit it.

  • Proven ability to build, manage, and grow external partner relationships at scale — ideally within cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance-adjacent ecosystems.

  • Experience partnering with systems integrators, MSPs, VARs, and audit firms; direct audit or assessor experience is a plus but not required.

  • Strong instincts for balancing technical/domain credibility with business development thinking

  • Track record of building or scaling a partner or channel network, reducing risk through diversification, or driving quality programs in an external-facing capacity

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functionally across GTM, product, legal, marketing, and channel sales teams

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and building structure in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's App Primitives team owns the shared building blocks that span data structures to UI: comments, notifications, event logs, feature flags, and task management. We own the general infrastructure; product teams own the logic built on top. Getting this layer right unlocks velocity for every team at Vanta.

As the Engineering Manager, App Primitives at Vanta, you'll lead the team building the shared product primitives that every Vanta product team depends on, owning the infrastructure layer that makes collaboration, communication, and core workflows possible across the entire platform.

Our Engineering Managers develop and grow high-performing teams that deliver significant value to our customers and enable our business to scale. This role sits at the intersection of technical architecture and team development, with real authority to set direction and grow a world-class platform team.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

What you’ll do as an Engineering Manager at Vanta:

  • Lead and grow the App Primitives team, owning hiring, team health, delivery, and the development of senior engineers and technical leads

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta's shared product primitives: comments infrastructure, notifications platform, event log, feature flag system (Statsig), and task management

  • Define and steward the interface model between App Primitives systems and product teams, ensuring product teams can build on top of shared infrastructure quickly and safely, without owning the underlying systems themselves

  • Partner closely with product engineering leaders across Vanta to surface developer needs, identify friction in shared systems, and prioritize investments that unlock velocity at scale

  • Set technical direction for a full-stack team working across data models, backend services, and UI primitives, and earn the trust of senior engineers through strong technical judgment

  • Manage cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations across concurrent workstreams, operating with a high degree of autonomy

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience with 2+ years managing engineering teams, including a track record of developing senior engineers and technical leads

  • Experience leading platform, shared services, or product infrastructure teams — where your team's output is what other teams build on

  • Technical fluency across the full stack, with enough depth in backend systems, shared data models, and API design to engage substantively with your team's technical decisions

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator: able to partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to define clear ownership boundaries and drive alignment across teams

  • Track record of hiring senior engineers in a competitive market and building a team culture people want to be part of

  • Experience managing multi-team dependencies and delivering across concurrent workstreams with limited oversight

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As the Engineering Manager, App Primitives at Vanta, you'll lead the team building the shared product primitives that every Vanta product team depends on, owning the infrastructure layer that makes collaboration, communication, and core workflows possible across the entire platform.

Our Engineering Managers develop and grow high-performing teams that deliver significant value to our customers and enable our business to scale. This role sits at the intersection of technical architecture and team development, with real authority to set direction and grow a world-class platform team.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

What you’ll do as an Engineering Manager at Vanta:

  • Lead and grow the App Primitives team, owning hiring, team health, delivery, and the development of senior engineers and technical leads

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta's shared product primitives: comments infrastructure, notifications platform, event log, feature flag system (Statsig), and task management

  • Define and steward the interface model between App Primitives systems and product teams, ensuring product teams can build on top of shared infrastructure quickly and safely, without owning the underlying systems themselves

  • Partner closely with product engineering leaders across Vanta to surface developer needs, identify friction in shared systems, and prioritize investments that unlock velocity at scale

  • Set technical direction for a full-stack team working across data models, backend services, and UI primitives, and earn the trust of senior engineers through strong technical judgment

  • Manage cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations across concurrent workstreams, operating with a high degree of autonomy

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience with 2+ years managing engineering teams, including a track record of developing senior engineers and technical leads

  • Experience leading platform, shared services, or product infrastructure teams — where your team's output is what other teams build on

  • Technical fluency across the full stack, with enough depth in backend systems, shared data models, and API design to engage substantively with your team's technical decisions

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator: able to partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to define clear ownership boundaries and drive alignment across teams

  • Track record of hiring senior engineers in a competitive market and building a team culture people want to be part of

  • Experience managing multi-team dependencies and delivering across concurrent workstreams with limited oversight

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n in Canada:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Pension contribution

  • 16 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Flexible work hours and location

  • 21 days of Vacation Time and 80 hours of Sick Leave

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-remote

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Strategic Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Finance team, you’ll play a pivotal role in uncovering the insights that shape company-wide planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making. This high-impact role blends analytical rigor, technical fluency, and business acumen to steer strategy and identify opportunities for scalable growth.

The Finance Data team partners with both Finance and other teams across Vanta. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders to build trust and deliver data-driven recommendations; your work will influence everything from operating plans and investment decisions to self-serve reporting and process automation. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your analytics expertise in a dynamic, high-growth environment, with visibility into executive-level priorities and the ability to shape them with data.

What you’ll do as a Senior Data Analyst at Vanta:

  • Deliver strategic insights by conducting deep, prioritized analyses that inform high-impact financial decisions.

  • Act as a technical partner to teams across FP&A, Accounting, RevOps, Product, Marketing, and more.

  • Increase team efficiency by automating recurring deliverables and helping scale workflows as the company grows.

  • Empower decision-makers with self-service dashboards and data assets that surface trends and drive informed choices across the business.

  • Advance our analytics infrastructure by partnering with Data Engineering and other analytics teams to democratize access to high quality data and insights.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in data analysis or equivalent function. Exposure to FP&A, Accounting, or SaaS metrics is a plus.

  • Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Sigma), with experience handling large and complex data sets. Familiarity with DBT is preferred. Bonus points for skill in Python for advanced analysis.

  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to analyze complex data sets, uncover key insights, and translate findings into actionable strategies that drive financial outcomes.

  • Collaboration: Demonstrated success working cross-functionally and building relationships across business teams. Comfortable engaging stakeholders with varying levels of data fluency.

  • Communication: Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal. Skilled at presenting complex data insights to non-technical audiences.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Informatics, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Governance, Risk, and Compliance Expert, GTM - V4G
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As one of Vanta’s GTM-facing GRC Subject Matter Experts supporting Vanta for Government (V4G) opportunities, you will be a highly visible, customer-facing leader within Vanta’s Security team, responsible for representing Vanta’s Trust Management Platform to prospects and customers, bringing deep public-sector compliance expertise across FedRAMP, GovRAMP, TX-RAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC 2.0, and NIST 800-171. You will also have a role in collaborating with internal teams to help drive and implement new V4G product features. This role is specifically involved with Vanta's pre-sales and marketing motions, owning V4G GRC conversations for net-new prospects and the expansion of existing customers' use of the product, as well as supporting marketing efforts by representing Vanta in public-facing conversations and speaking engagements.

If this sounds like you, and you're excited to use your Security, Privacy, and broader Gov-focused GRC experience to help grow and sell our product, we'd love to hear from you.

Candidates must be based in Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zones for this role.

What you’ll do as a Governance, Risk, and Compliance Expert, GTM - V4G at Vanta:

  • Use your expert knowledge of compliance frameworks like FedRAMP, GovRAMP, TX-RAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC 2.0, and NIST 800-171, to advise customers regarding questions about scoping, policy creation, detailed control requirements and security best practices, and recommend implementations within Vanta’s product related to these frameworks.

  • Partner with Vanta's Sales, Account Management, and Solutions Engineering teams and own public-sector GRC discussions & activities, representing Vanta’s Trust Management Platform to prospects/customers.

  • Become an expert in V4G product features to translate how they can help optimize prospect/customer public-sector GRC workflows.

  • Engage with executives and senior staff at prospect and customer organizations to establish relationships with customer security, privacy, and AI teams.

  • Answer questions from internal and external stakeholders on GRC programs, including program foundation/scaling strategies, framework-specific requirements, third-party risk management, and broader IT, security, privacy, and enterprise risk workflows - and how Vanta's platform supports each.

  • Develop publicly-available marketing and education content focused on public-sector GRC for prospects, customers, and partners.

  • Represent Vanta in public-facing activities including speaking on webinars & panels, participating in conferences, networking at Vanta/partner-led events, and other marketing or thought leadership events.

  • Partner with GTM Enablement teams to design and deliver training for Vanta's Sales and Account Management orgs on GRC and Vanta product disciplines across security, privacy, and AI governance.

  • Identify customer requirements that expand or improve Vanta’s product across security, privacy, and AI governance, and provide input and feedback for feature development.

  • Travel roughly twice per quarter (a few days to a week) for customer onsites, POC workshops, team offsites, and other events.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience US government compliance, with direct experience taking an organization to FedRAMP Ready or Authorized, assessing as a 3PAO, or both.

  • Working knowledge of federal frameworks such as FedRAMP (all impact levels and the program's active modernization), CMMC 2.0, NIST 800-53 and 800-171, and StateRAMP/state-program dynamics .

  • Foundational knowledge of baseline security compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 & SOC 2.

  • Strong understanding of of SSP and POA&M authorship-level familiarity as well as ConMon operations

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, version control systems, risk management, vulnerability management, and their related security processes.

  • Experience with third-party/vendor risk management (TPRM) processes, including due diligence, risk scoring, risk assessments, and ongoing monitoring processes.

  • Background in broader IT, security, and/or enterprise risk management workflows, including risk scoring, likelihood/impact analysis, and treatment planning.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to deliver high-impact learning experiences and earn credibility with experienced, senior-level sellers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable engaging customer-facing stakeholders, including C-level contacts, security & privacy leaders, and legal teams, as well as more public partner and industry audiences.

  • Comfortable using AI to amplify and strengthen GRC work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Enterprise sales process literacy (e.g., MEDDPICC) preferred, but not required.

  • Customer Trust or Sales Engineering experience preferred, but not required.

  • Certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, RP, CCA, CCP) and/or formal education preferred, but not required.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

This role is specifically involved with Vanta's pre-sales and marketing motions, owning GRC conversations for net-new prospects and the expansion of existing customers' use of the Vanta product, as well as supporting marketing efforts by representing Vanta in public-facing conversations and speaking engagements.

  • Become an expert in Vanta’s product features to translate how they can help optimize prospect/customer GRC workflows.

  • Engage with executives and senior staff at prospect and customer organizations to establish relationships with customer security, privacy, and AI teams.

  • Answer questions from internal and external stakeholders on GRC programs, including program foundation/scaling strategies, framework-specific requirements, third-party risk management, and broader IT, security, privacy, and enterprise risk workflows - and how Vanta's platform supports each.

  • Develop publicly-available marketing and education content for prospects, customers, and partners.

  • Represent Vanta in public-facing activities including speaking on webinars & panels, participating in conferences, networking at Vanta/partner-led events, and other marketing or thought leadership events.

  • Partner with GTM Enablement teams to design and deliver training for Vanta's Sales and Account Management orgs on GRC and Vanta product disciplines across security, privacy, and AI governance.

  • Identify customer requirements that expand or improve Vanta’s product across security, privacy, and AI governance, and provide input and feedback for feature development.

  • Travel roughly twice per quarter (a few days to a week) for customer onsites, POC workshops, team offsites, and other events.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience implementing and/or consulting on multi-unit/entity and/or multi-framework GRC programs, including compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, GDPR, and HIPAA.

  • Technical expertise to understand and explain security, privacy, and GRC concepts

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, version control systems, risk management, vulnerability management, and their related security processes.

  • Experience with third-party/vendor risk management (TPRM) processes, including due diligence, risk scoring, risk assessments, and ongoing monitoring processes.

  • Background in broader IT, security, and/or enterprise risk management workflows, including risk scoring, likelihood/impact analysis, and treatment planning.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to deliver high-impact learning experiences and earn credibility with experienced, senior-level sellers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable engaging customer-facing stakeholders, including C-level contacts, security & privacy leaders, and legal teams, as well as more public partner and industry audiences.

  • Comfortable using AI to amplify and strengthen GRC work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Enterprise sales process literacy (e.g., MEDDPICC) preferred, but not required.

  • Customer Trust or Sales Engineering experience preferred, but not required.

  • Certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CIPP/E, ISO 42001 Lead Auditor/Implementor) and/or formal education preferred, but not required.

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Account Executive - Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

[Tokyo, Japan based role]

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our Japan presence, and we need talented, customer-focused Account Executives who are excited to help build our Japan foundation. We're building a Sales team with Account Executives who will take ownership of their entire sales cycle, build our sales motion as we create our Japan presence, and distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

Vanta is growing quickly, we're profitable, and we're continually outpacing our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores. Our Sales team is leading the charge in exceeding our revenue goals and growing our market share as the industry leader in compliance and security in the US, and it’s time to do it internationally.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in Japan, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta

  • Turn our inbound demand into closed-new business and happy Vanta customers

  • Manage our sales pipeline, improving and maturing our sales process and playbook

  • Define and communicate the specific benefits of Vanta appropriate for each customer, including making sales materials and demos

  • Collect insights from prospects for our product development process

  • Help us grow the market by exploring new partnership opportunities, attending industry events and building awareness

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the Japan landing team

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-Competitive Salary and Equity

  • Healthcare stipend towards health insurance for you and your dependents

  • Paid maternity leave, and 4 weeks of paternity leave for fathers

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Staff Software Engineers identify key strategic technical initiatives, deliver significant value to our customers and business, and set the tone for engineering excellence and culture. As a Staff Software Engineer on the team based in London, you will play a key role in growing our engineering presence in Europe. You'll partner with product management, product design, and your growing engineering team to drive the discovery and development of privacy, AI, and risk management features that expand Vanta’s value for its customers - working in a domain where technical decisions carry real compliance and data-governance weight, not just product tradeoffs. Your work will accelerate product development and create a consistent customer experience for all of our customer segments.

Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

This role is remote-first. For engineers based in the London area, we ask for 2–3 days per week in the office. For engineers based elsewhere in the UK/Ireland, we expect occasional travel to London (roughly once per quarter, <20% of your time).

Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We’d love for you to join us!

What you’ll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

  • Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for core products to evolve and scale into highly performant, reliable, and customizable systems

  • Design, develop, and own new product functionality and/or infrastructure leveraging modern frameworks and tooling (TypeScript, React, Node.js)

  • Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation

  • Set technical direction that shapes how multiple teams build in the privacy and AI governance spaces - not just a single project's outcome

  • Help stand up and shape engineering practices as we grow our footprint in the UK/Ireland, including interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new teammates

  • Act as a cultural beacon, setting a high bar for engineering culture and excellence, and multiply the impact of the teams around you through mentorship and technical leadership

How to be successful in this role:

  • At least 10 years of industry experience as a software engineer

  • Served as a technical lead for large projects (6+ months in length), including defining the roadmap for complex projects spanning multiple teams and functions

  • Have set technical direction or built systems whose impact extended beyond your immediate team - e.g., shared infrastructure, cross-team standards, or platform decisions other teams built on

  • Built successful SaaS products for both startup and enterprise users

  • Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action

  • Upleveled teams of engineers by mentoring and leading by example

  • Experience working at rapidly scaling startups and large companies, especially with environments that prioritize a bias for action

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits and lunch allowance for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team-building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience at Vanta, you will define how AI agents help security and compliance teams accomplish meaningful work with greater clarity, control, and trust across Vanta and the surfaces where our customers already work.

The Agent Experience team builds agent-led experiences that help security and compliance teams achieve outcomes with less manual effort. The team owns the agent harness, including agents, skills, tools, and memory, as well as the patterns that help customers understand, guide, review, correct, and trust agent-generated work. Our goal is to make AI-powered workflows useful, transparent, and dependable in a product where clarity and correctness matter.

As a Senior Product Designer on this team, you will shape both the underlying agent experience and the customer-facing workflows built on top of it. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, AI Quality, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous problems into thoughtful, scalable, and trustworthy experiences. The patterns you establish will influence product teams across Vanta.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Designer, Agent Experience at Vanta:

  • Lead end-to-end design for projects across the agent harness, from problem framing and discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Define how agents, skills, tools, and memory are composed, surfaced, and understood by customers.

  • Design experiences that help customers delegate real security and compliance work while maintaining visibility, control, and confidence.

  • Create patterns for reviewing, correcting, approving, interrupting, and recovering from agent-generated work.

  • Design conversational and agent interaction models across Vanta, Slack, and other surfaces where our agents appear.

  • Establish product patterns and principles for trustworthy agent behavior, including transparency, permissions, uncertainty, explainability, and graceful failure.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate when an agent is the right solution for a customer problem.

  • Conduct customer discovery and usability testing with security, compliance, and GRC users.

  • Translate customer insights, product requirements, technical constraints, and AI quality considerations into clear design direction.

  • Collaborate with Design Systems and product designers across Vanta to turn emerging AI patterns into reusable, high-quality experiences.

  • Create design briefs, workflow models, prototypes, specifications, and other artifacts that bring clarity to complex problems.

  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership.

  • Contribute to design critique and help raise the quality bar for interaction design, information architecture, UX writing, and visual craft.

  • Help shape how Vanta approaches responsible AI and human control across the product.

  • Identify opportunities to improve how the design organization and product teams work together.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with depth in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or other sophisticated software products.

  • Experience designing AI-powered products, automation, or systems where product behavior may be dynamic or uncertain.

  • Ability to design agent experiences beyond chat, including systems involving agents, skills, tools, memory, and multi-step workflows.

  • Experience designing products that require human judgment, including deciding when and how to bring a person into an automated workflow.

  • Experience designing across surfaces that a product team may not fully control, such as Slack, terminal environments, or other third-party interfaces.

  • Strong product thinking and discovery skills, including the ability to frame ambiguous problems and identify the right questions to answer.

  • High craft in interaction design, information architecture, UX writing, and visual design.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and customer-facing teams.

  • A thoughtful approach to responsible AI, including transparency, data control, human review, explainability, and recovery from incorrect or incomplete outputs.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates shipped work, complex workflows, meaningful tradeoffs, and learning from customers or users.

  • Ability to move fluidly between systems-level thinking and detailed interaction design.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners without formal authority.

  • Curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort working in emerging product spaces where patterns and best practices are still taking shape.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

Reporting directly to the Head of Public Sector, this is a highly visible role that requires cross-functional collaboration, strategic vision, and operational execution.

  • Partner closely with SLED-specific resellers, distributors, MSPs, and channel partners to expand access and accelerate deals.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the SLED market, helping inform Vanta’s product roadmap, pricing strategy, service delivery, and positioning to meet customer needs.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of progressive enterprise sales experience, including at least 4 years selling to SLED agencies within a SaaS company. Experience working in government is a plus.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset that biases to action and leads with resilience through a fast-moving, complex, and collaborative environment.

  • Strong understanding of SLED sales cycles, SLED procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements (e.g., GovRAMP), acquisition regulations, and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong verbal and written communications skills, with the ability to demonstrate Vanta’s vision and values to a variety of public sector audiences.

  • Develop a deep familiarity with Vanta’s software platform and how it can be used by government agencies to support real-world challenges. The ability to establish rapport with highly technical prospects is essential.

  • Strong collaboration with internal partners and external counterparts.

  • A deep passion for Vanta’s mission, public sector innovation, and mission-driven work.
