jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Partner Marketing at Vanta drives revenue growth and market expansion through high-impact cloud, technology and ecosystem partnerships. Our team builds and invests in joint campaigns, co-marketing initiatives, and MDF programs to generate pipeline, accelerate deals, and deepen partner relationships. As we scale, repeatable programs, partner-ready plays, and data-driven insights are critical to maximizing the impact of our partner investments.

As the Senior Manager, Partner Marketing Programs at Vanta, you will build, scale and execute the foundational engine behind our global partner marketing strategy. This is a highly visible, highly cross functional role working closely with partner product marketing, partner enablement, partner marketing, partner sales, systems and finance. You will champion three critical focus areas to propel our partnership strategy forward:

  1. Orchestrate high-impact partner communications and community engagement—including product launches, enablement webinars, and an active partner community—designed to keep partners fully enabled, deeply engaged, and continuously choosing Vanta.

  2. Maximize Market Development Fund (MDF) Impact and ROI—strategically allocating, tracking, and optimizing investments to turn MDF into a high-yield engine for measurable pipeline expansion across our entire partner ecosystem.

  3. Scale partner pipegen programs by transforming Vanta's campaign calendar and product roadmap into robust, partner-ready packages, campaign kits, and sales plays that drive joint pipeline.

Reporting to the Head of Global Strategic Partner Marketing, you will empower our partner network to grow and scale with clarity and confidence—turning strategic investments into real growth. You will ensure partner programs are properly resourced, tracked, and optimized across all six of our partner ecosystems — Solution Providers and VARs, Cloud Service Providers, Service Providers and MSPs, Audit Partners, GSIs, and Technology Partners — while equipping the team and leadership with the reporting and insight needed to make smart, fast decisions.

What you’ll do as a Partner Marketing Programs Manager at Vanta:

  • Lead partner communications, product launches, and enablement webinars while building an active partner community to ensure our ecosystem stays continuously engaged, fully enabled, and inspired to choose Vanta.

  • Run the Vanta partner community as a core pillar of the partner program — owning the rhythm of content, enablement moments, recognition, and connection that makes partners feel like insiders

  • Oversee partner funding and MDF programs, including AWS MDF processes, SCAs, compliance requirements, budget management and payment process execution

  • Drive the end-to-end partner marketing lifecycle—from strategic planning and global investment allocation to rigorous lead flow management, attribution tracking, and ROI analysis—ensuring every initiative fuels continuous growth and measurable pipeline impact.

  • Translate Vanta's campaign calendar and product roadmap into partner-ready plays, then put them directly into the hands of our regional and ecosystem partners to activate and our strategic partner marketers to make bespoke and activate with their partners

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5-7+ years of experience in partner programs, partner marketing, partner marketing operations, partner marketing communications

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with a bias for action

  • Prior experience building and scaling partner or channel marketing programs — packaged campaigns, co-marketing kits, partner plays, or partner communities

  • Experience supporting partner marketing teams budgets and managing MDF programs (AWS MDF and SCAs strongly preferred)

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a full program lifecycle from planning through launch, tracking, and reporting

  • Highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable in a startup environment where speed and ownership matter

  • Open to using AI to amplify skills and strengthen work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce reporting and dashboard creation. Experience with Tableau (or similar BI tools)

  • Advanced Excel expertise (complex formulas, pivot tables, modeling, data connectors, automation)

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Early Stage
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As an Early Stage Sales Manager at Vanta, you’ll have the opportunity to build, lead, and develop a team of ambitious Account Executives focused on helping early-stage companies grow securely. You'll collaborate closely with senior leadership and cross-functional partners including product, marketing, and engineering to expand our presence in the small business segment. Your work will directly shape Vanta’s go-to-market strategy as we scale, refine our sales motion, and strengthen our position as the leading trust management platform for early stage companies.

You'll partner with your team to drive new business growth, working with founders and early operators at fast-growing companies to transform how they approach security and compliance. This is your chance to make a substantial impact at an innovative, mission-driven company.

The Early Stage segment in North America is the top-performing team at Vanta. Our reps are averaging 145% quota attainment. The segment closed at 119% of target this period. You'd be stepping into a proven, high-performing part of the business with real momentum, and the room to push it further.

What you’ll do as a Early Stage Sales Manager at Vanta:

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a small but high-performing team of Account Executives, equipping them with the tools and guidance to succeed in fast-paced, founder-led sales cycles.

  • Drive new business growth through proactive prospecting, consultative selling, and ownership of the full sales cycle.

  • Build and refine repeatable sales playbooks and processes that can scale as the team grows.

  • Provide accurate forecasting and pipeline management, ensuring visibility for leadership and investors.

  • Partner closely with early customers to understand their needs and influence Vanta’s product roadmap.

  • Continuously evolve Vanta’s sales approach by introducing new tactics and solutions to shorten cycles, improve win rates, and drive overall revenue growth.

  • Actively contribute to scaling the team through recruiting, onboarding, and training new Account Executives.

  • Foster an inclusive and supportive sales culture aligned with Vanta’s core values.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, competitors, and the challenges of scaling early stage businesses.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 4+ years of experience selling B2B SaaS to early stage and small businesses, with 1–2 years in a leadership or management role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas, both as an individual contributor and as a leader.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Program Structure & Trust
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

 

What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

  • Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

  • Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

  • Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

  • Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

  • Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

  • Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

  • A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

  • A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

  • Strong communication skills — you make complex systems legible to engineering leadership, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders, in writing and in the room

  • Data residency or GovCloud exposure is a plus; the right person ramps on this in a quarter once the core structural problems are in hand

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are seeking an experienced Director of Enterprise Sales to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Director of Enterprise Sales at Vanta:

  • Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

  • Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

  • Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

  • Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

  • Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

  • Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

  • Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

  • Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

  • Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

  • Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

  • Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

  • Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

  • Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

  • Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

  • Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As Senior Product Manager of Document Management, you will be responsible for agent-led content management, guiding customers through agentic workflows to generate and maintain documents and procedures tailored to their business. Today, this process is slow, manual, and often stressful for companies. These artifacts are foundational to how a company’s security program operates—requiring customers to interpret multiple compliance requirements, establish processes, and define how those processes run, all while ensuring they will meet auditor expectations.

As Senior Product Manager for Document Management, you will work cross functionally to build an agentic solution to automate these gap assessments, helping customers more quickly achieve their security and business objectives by scaling to new frameworks faster.

By guiding and automating the creation, editing, and management of content end-to-end, you will help customers dramatically shorten the path to audit readiness and scaling their compliance program, while building confidence that their processes and documentation are aligned to their business needs.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the agentic document, policies, and procedure creation and editing workflows, as well as agentic gap assessments

  • Help customers evolve their security programs by building Agent workflows for surfacing recommendations and completing relevant actions

  • Deeply understand our customers and market, and translate their needs into clear Agent experiences that solve real compliance challenges

  • Partner with design and engineering to establish consistent interaction patterns—across chat, inline actions, and background automations—that make the Agent reliable, explainable, and safe

  • Deliver high-quality products that addresses key customer pain points and establishes Vanta’s leadership in AI powered GRC solutions

  • Help define and shape Vanta’s product team culture as we grow

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality SaaS/B2B and AI products

  • Have strong technical skills and experience shipping AI products, including writing and iterating on prompts, evaluating outputs, and driving systematic quality improvements

  • Possess a customer-focused mindset– proactively reach out to customers, synthesize feedback, and partner with go-to-market teams

  • Be deeply curious, empathetic, and user-centric, with a knack for driving effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders

  • Communicate with clarity and influence—both written and verbal—with team members, stakeholders, and executives

  • Have a learner’s mindset, a genuine passion for building AI products, and the grit to experiment, iterate, and fail

  • Have a deep interest in and knowledge of the evolving AI/ML ecosystem

  • Be data driven– you lean into qual signals from users and can dig into the quant side to inform roadmap & prioritization

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

  • Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

  • Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years closing experience

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Program Structure & Trust
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

 

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

 

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

 

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

 

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

 
 

What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

  • Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

  • Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

  • Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

  • Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

  • Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

  • Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

 

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

  • A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

  • A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

  • Strong communication skills — you make complex systems legible to engineering leadership, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders, in writing and in the room

  • Data residency or GovCloud exposure is a plus; the right person ramps on this in a quarter once the core structural problems are in hand

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Pension contribution

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Flexible work hours and location

  • 21 days of Vacation Time and 80 hours of Sick Leave

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

 

#LI-remote

 

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As the Senior Product Manager for Integrations at Vanta, you will be responsible for the ongoing development of integrations across categories, driving direct customer impact through new integrations and expanded capabilities. Vanta currently manages a catalog of over 400 integrations that help customers continuously monitor their compliance and generate the evidence needed to satisfy audit. You’ll drive planning and delivery for a wide range of integration categories and capabilities, such as HRIS/IDP systems, cloud and security platforms, and ticketing systems, building on top of the integrations platform.

 

You’ll be part of Vanta’s Automation group, which owns how customers discover and connect to other platforms through integrations, use that data to power product experiences and tests, drive customers toward compliance-related security outcomes, and ultimately generate the evidence required for audit. You will operate in a few different modes to build your roadmap, balancing direction from other product teams, customer input, and your own prioritization framework to make the right investments. Plus, you will get wide exposure to most parts of Vanta’s products.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Integrations at Vanta:

  • Drive integrations roadmap and strategy, determining which new integrations and capabilities are built based on inputs from other product teams, customers, and the broader business environment.

  • Pair closely with engineering and design counterparts to prioritize the backlog, plan the roadmap, and make crucial decisions about integration depth, capability, and sequencing.

  • Pair with the integration partnership lead to activate the right partners ahead of integration development and manage ongoing enhancements

  • Support the ongoing maintenance and improvement of existing integrations.

  • Work directly with customers to understand integration needs and document/prioritize their feedback.

  • Help tell the story around integrations with collaboration on marketing and field activities, training, and enablement. You’ll also help market our integrations and make them easier to discover and configure.

  • Measure and communicate metrics around integration breadth and depth, with an eye toward data availability and solving customer compliance needs.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 5+ years in a product role around integrations and ecosystem, with an established track record of prioritizing and building impactful integrations. Ideally, you’ve owned an integration catalog or category before.

  • Have a good sense of prioritization frameworks that help you effectively focus and sequence integrations work across teams.

  • Possess strong collaboration and communication skills, with comfort pairing with other product teams and stakeholders across the business.

  • Be technically fluent with comfort in integrations-related technology areas like APIs, authentication, and permissions

  • Be a strong planner, with experience coordinating multiple workstreams at once and keeping stakeholders informed and confident.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
